items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Gus Smith and Maude deForrest and myself, and Eddie Green, were the biggest people worth mentioning. Anyhow, Gus organized this thing. We went about doing tab shows... And all through Indiana and Illinois we did what you call tab shows

ctx.x: Anyhow, he -- they both left and from Indianapolis, went on to Chicago, and took what money. We were stranded out there.
Well, now, there was another fellow there named Gus Smith. Gus Smith knew what to do. I didn't know that to do.
